t: Mission Finds Leper Colony In Shanghai. February - March 1929

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 614
Date......3. 29

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, FRIDAY, MARCH 1, 1929.

Mission Finds Leper Colony
In Shanghai

A colony of more than 100 lepers has been discovered in Shanghai and steps have been taken by the Chinese Mission to Lepers and the Chinese Public Health Department to segregate them and take care of them, Mr. William Yinson Lee declared presiding at the annual meeting and dinner of the Mission last night.

Mr. Lee gave a review of the Mission's work during the past three years and announced an active interest on the part of the Ministry of Health in combating leprosy in China. The Shanghai municipality, he said, was considering the grant of an appropriate piece of land for a leper home in Shanghai which formed the object of the drive by the Mission, in conjunction with the "Y's" Men's Association and the Pan-Pacific Association last summer.

He added that the Mission has rendered financial assistance to several leper hospitals and homes and had supplied them free with the various oils which have curative properties in the treatment of leprosy. He made an appeal to the public for financial help to finance the eradication of leprosy in Shanghai and China.

Dr. Wu Lien-teh, the well-known plague authority, gave an authoritative speech on his experiences of leprosy in other countries. He declared there are 3,000,000 lepers in the world and not less than 1,000,000 are to be found in China, although the Chinese are recognized as the first people to have discovered the use of oils for the cure of leprosy. He said that the United States has the best system of leper control of all the countries he had visited on his extensive world trip.

《字林西报》，1929年3月1日，星期五。

传教团发现上海麻风病人群居地

中华麻风救济会（Chinese Mission to Lepers）主席李威廉（William Yinson Lee，音译）先生昨晚在该会年度会议及晚宴上宣布，在上海发现了一个拥有100多名麻风病人的群居地，中华麻风救济会与中国公共卫生部门已采取措施对他们进行隔离和照料。

李先生回顾了过去三年该会的工作，并宣布卫生部对中国抗击麻风病一事表现出积极的兴趣。他说，上海特别市正在考虑拨出一块合适的土地用于在上海建立麻风病院，这也是该会去年夏天与“Y”男士协会（"Y's" Men's Association）及泛太平洋协会联合发起运动的目标。

他补充说，该会已向几家麻风病院和收容所提供财政援助，并免费向他们供应各种对治疗麻风病具有疗效的油类。他呼吁公众提供财政帮助，以资助消除上海及中国的麻风病。

著名的鼠疫专家伍连德博士就其在其他国家对麻风病的经验发表了权威演讲。他宣称，全世界有300万麻风病人，其中中国不少于100万，尽管中国人被公认为是最早发现使用油类治愈麻风病的民族。他说，在他广泛的环球旅行中所访问的国家里，美国拥有最好的麻风病控制体系。

C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 64
Date 20/2/29 ... 16. 2. 29

THE SHANGHAI SUNDAY TIMES, FEBRUARY 24, 1929.

Further Investigation Into
Local Leprosy Cases

Eight persons suffering from leprosy were found in one Chinese home in territory a few yards from the Settlement by the Bureau of Health of the Chinese Municipality. A shocking condition in the district was revealed to the Bureau by a foreign lady doctor who stated that she believes there are more than 100 cases of leprosy within a radius of a mile in the Dixwell Road district.

The eight persons suffering from the disease proved to be Kompo coolies, who have been living in huts or on boats. They recently banded together and took up residence in a single house. Investigation revealed that the conditions under which they have been living were appalling. Eleven other persons not afflicted with the disease were living in the same house.

In another case the Bureau found a leper whose mother, two sisters and a cousin had the same disease. One of the lepers slept with two young boys not afflicted with leprosy.

Plans are being discussed by the Chinese Leprosy Remedy Association for the establishment of a hospital for these unfortunate persons. It is planned to appeal to the National Government for part of the necessary funds, and to raise the remainder of the money by appealing to the public for contributions.

Three foreign doctors are daily going into this leprosy district and treating patients free of charge, even supplying the necessary medicine without charge.

《上海星期时报》，1929年2月24日。

进一步调查本地麻风病例

中国特别市卫生局在距租界仅几码远的华界地区的一户中国家庭中发现了八名麻风病患者。一位外国女医生向该局揭示了该地区令人震惊的状况，她表示相信在狄思威路（Dixwell Road）地区方圆一英里内有超过100例麻风病病例。

这八名患病者经查证均为广东苦力，他们一直居住在棚屋或船上。最近他们聚集在一起，合租了一栋房子。调查显示，他们的生活条件极其恶劣。另有十一名未患病者也居住在同一栋房子里。

在另一起案件中，该局发现一名麻风病患者，其母亲、两个姐妹和一个表亲也患有同样的疾病。其中一名麻风病患者与两名未患麻风病的小男孩同睡。

中华麻风救济会正在讨论为这些不幸的人建立一所医院的计划。计划向国民政府申请部分必要资金，其余资金则通过向公众募捐筹集。

三名外国医生每天进入这个麻风病区，免费治疗病人，甚至免费提供必要的药物。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, SATURDAY, FEBRUARY 23, 1929.

LEPERS DISCOVERED
IN SHANGHAI

Investigation Reveals
Many Live On Border
Of Settlement

The Health Bureau of the
Greater Shanghai Municipality
Monday sent two experts, Dr. Ou
Li-Kouo and Dr. Young Nyoh-chan,
with the Rev. T. C. Wu, the
general secretary of the Chinese
Mission to Lepers, to make an
investigation of leprosy in Hong-
kew District between the Settle-
ment boundary on Dixwell Road
and the end of Kungping Road.
Led by a guide who knows the
location of the lepers the Com-
mission made a house-to-house in-
quiry among the population of
boatmen, wheel-barrow coolies,
pedlers and beggars. The results
were most astonishing. Fully
developed lepers were dis-
covered within the distance of one
li. They all live in small huts
and tiny boats, the condition of
which is almost indescribable.
These victims of the dread disease
generally stay with their friends
or other members of the family in
a tiny room and usually sleep in
the same beds with others. One
leper boy who lives in Hong Chung,
No. 1113 shares his bed with his
two little brothers who, unless by
a miracle, are bound to contract
the disease. The mother, aged
36, has already got the symptom
of leprosy in having fading eye-
brows.
According to the estimate of
Dr. Elizabeth Shapleigh who has
been working in that district for
some time the number of lepers
in that section of Shanghai can
easily run from one to two hund-
red including those who are in
hiding.
The Health Bureau of Greater
Shanghai is now making a
survey of the whole city
of Shanghai by sending
out questionnaires to all the
hospitals and medical practitioners
as to the extent of leprosy cases.
The Chinese Mission to Lepers
states:—"Those of us who have
been living in good health and in
comfort have never dreamed that
Shanghai had so many lepers.
The appalling condition of leprosy
in our midst ought to be a chall-
enge both to the Chinese and
Settlement authorities and to
every right-thinking man and
woman for immediate action."

（批：a/D.C.I. Information J.W.S. 25/2/29.）

《字林西报》，1929年2月23日，星期六。

在上海发现麻风病人

调查显示许多人生活在租界边缘

大上海特别市卫生局于周一派遣了两名专家，欧立国博士（Dr. Ou Li-Kouo，音译）和杨耀章博士（Dr. Young Nyoh-chan，音译），会同中华麻风救济会总干事吴铁城牧师（Rev. T. C. Wu），对虹口地区狄思威路（Dixwell Road）租界边界至公平路（Kungping Road）尽头之间的麻风病情况进行调查。在一位熟悉麻风病人位置的向导带领下，委员会在船民、独轮车苦力、小贩和乞丐人群中进行了挨家挨户的询问。结果令人极为震惊。在一里地的距离内就发现了处于发病期的麻风病人。他们都住在小棚屋和小船上，其状况几乎无法形容。这些可怕疾病的受害者通常与朋友或其他家庭成员挤在一个小房间里，并且通常与他人同床共枕。一名住在鸿忠里1113号（Hong Chung, No. 1113，音译）的麻风病少年与他的两个弟弟共用一张床，除非出现奇迹，否则这两个孩子注定会感染这种疾病。他们36岁的母亲眉毛脱落，已经出现了麻风病的症状。

根据在该地区工作了一段时间的伊丽莎白·夏普利博士（Dr. Elizabeth Shapleigh）的估计，上海该地区的麻风病人数量很容易达到一到两百人，其中包括那些隐藏起来的病人。

大上海特别市卫生局目前正通过向所有医院和执业医师发放问卷，对整个上海市的麻风病例范围进行调查。

中华麻风救济会声明：“我们这些生活健康舒适的人从未梦想过上海有这么多麻风病人。我们中间麻风病的可怕状况应当是对中国和租界当局以及每一位有良知的男女发出的立即采取行动的挑战。”

（批：a/D.C.I. 供参考 J.W.S. 1929年2月25日。）

C O P Y.

LEPROSY IN DIXWELL ROAD DISTRICT.

The Sin Wan Pao, the Eastern Times and other
local newspapers publish the following report:-

On February 18 the Bureau of Health of the
Shanghai (Chinese Territory) Municipality detailed
Drs. Yang Nyoh Chila ( ) and Wu Lee Koh ( )
to co-operate with Wu Ts Chien ( ) of the Chinese
Leprosy Remedy Association to make an investigation of the
people living at a place in Chinese Territory near Dixwell
Road and Kungping Road who are suffering from leprosy. The
officials found the residents to be all Kompo coolies
who live in huts or boats. Their conditions are
very insanitary. The officials discovered eight persons
suffering from leprosy living in houses with other members
of their families.
A man named Lieu Zien Tseng ( ) suffering
from leprosy, states that he lives at No. I,113 Hung Tseng
( )and sleeps in the same bed with two younger
brothers. His mother is 36 years of age but all her eye-
brows have disappeared on account of leprosy.
A foreign lady doctor Zia Po Li ( ) who
is well acquainted with the situation there, stated that
she believes that there are at least over 100 persons
suffering from this disease who are living within a
radius of one mile and whose condition is pitiful.
The Chinese Leprosy Association (Remedy) is going to
establish a hospital for such patients.

狄思威路地区的麻风病。

《新闻报》、《时事新报》及其他本地报纸刊登了以下报道：

2月18日，上海（华界）特别市卫生局派遣杨耀查拉博士（Yang Nyoh Chila，音译）和吴李科博士（Wu Lee Koh，音译）与中华麻风救济会的吴铁坚（Wu Ts Chien，音译）合作，调查居住在狄思威路和公平路附近华界某地且患有麻风病的人员。官员们发现居民均为居住在棚屋或船上的广东苦力。他们的卫生状况非常糟糕。官员们发现有八名麻风病患者与其家庭成员共同居住在房屋内。

一名名叫刘增（Lieu Zien Tseng，音译）的麻风病患者称，他住在鸿增里1113号（Hung Tseng，音译），并与两个弟弟同睡一张床。他的母亲36岁，但因患麻风病眉毛已全部脱落。

一位熟悉当地情况的外国女医生夏波利（Zia Po Li，音译）表示，她相信至少有一百多名患有此病的人生活在方圆一英里范围内，其状况令人怜悯。

中华麻风救济会（治疗部）打算为此类患者建立一所医院。

SHANGHAI MERCURY, THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 14, 1929.

LEPROSY IN HARBIN.
Victim to Come to Shanghai.

A leper has been discovered among the workmen at the timber concession of the C.E.R. at Shitouhedze station. The victim is a Chinese, 34 years old, and is plainly showing the revolting symptoms of the dreaded disease.
He was brought to Harbin and placed into the isolation ward of the Plague Prevention Institute at Fuchiatien. However, as there does not exist a leprosorium in Manchuria, he will be transferred in the nearest future to Shanghai, which possesses such an institution.
At the hospital, the man volunteered the information that some two or three other workmen who were living in the same barracks with him were also victims to leprosy. An investigation which was immediately carried out failed, however, to substantiate his statement. However all the men who came into contact with the diseased will be kept under medical surveillance for some time to come.

（批：Mr Yao,
Where is the local
leprosorium?
JHS
16/2/29.）

（批：Sir,
There is no leprosorium
in Shanghai, but it is

《上海泰晤士报》，1929年2月14日，星期四。

哈尔滨的麻风病。
患者将前往上海。

在中东铁路石头河子站（Shitouhedze station）的木材特许经营区工人中发现了一名麻风病患者。受害者是一名34岁的中国人，明显显示出这种可怕疾病的令人厌恶的症状。
他被带到哈尔滨，并被安置在傅家甸（Fuchiatien）防疫研究所的隔离病房。然而，由于满洲里没有麻风病院，他将在不久的将来被转送到拥有此类机构的上海。
在医院里，此人主动提供信息称，与他住在同一营房里的另外两三名工人也是麻风病患者。然而，随即进行的调查未能证实他的说法。不过，所有与病人接触过的人都将在未来一段时间内接受医疗监视。

（批：姚先生，
本地的
麻风病院在哪里？
JHS
1929年2月16日。）

（批：长官，
上海没有麻风病院，但据报道杭州城外松木场（Sung Moh Yang）有一家。）
